@@U03672@@
I’ve seen for hundreds of years now bustling about among all those pallid ghosts.

@@U03674@@
(On the rocks.)

@@U03675@@
What clouds are those I see streaming Round about the moon so bright? They are doves, love-kindled, gleaming, Their wings as white as purest light. 帕福斯 sent them to us, glowing Harbingers of love and joy; Our feast is perfect now, overflowing Full with bliss without alloy!

@@U03677@@
(Joining 泰勒斯.)

@@U03678@@
Some night wanderer might call that ring round the moon a fanciful nocturnal illusion, but we spirits see it quite differently, and, indeed, in the only correct way. They are doves escorting my daughter's seashell ride. A rare and wondrous flight it is, too, taught them in days of old.

@@U03680@@
What can be better than a good man’s simple faith, nurtured in a gentle heart? What else has a better reason to be right? PSYLLI and MARSI: (Mounted on sea bulls, sea calves, and sea rams.) In 塞浦路斯’s rude caverns, not swamped by 涅普顿's waves, unshattered by 塞斯摩斯, with eternal breezes blowing round, we, we guard the chariot of 维纳斯, guard it as in ancient times, with peace and quiet contentment.
translation:
@@U03672@@
数百年来我一直看到这些苍白的鬼魂在其中忙碌。

@@U03674@@
（在岩石上。）

@@U03675@@
我看到什么云围绕着如此明亮的月亮流动？它们是鸽子，被爱点燃，闪闪发光，它们的翅膀像最纯净的光一样洁白。 帕福斯将它们送给我们，是爱与欢乐的光辉预兆；我们的盛宴现在完美了，充满了无合金的幸福！

@@U03677@@
（加入泰勒斯。）

@@U03678@@
有些夜行者可能会称月亮周围的光环是一种奇特的夜间幻象，但我们的灵魂却以完全不同的方式看待它，而且确实以唯一正确的方式看待它。它们是护航我女儿贝壳之旅的鸽子。这也是一种罕见而奇妙的飞行，在很久以前就教会了他们。

@@U03680@@
还有什么比一个好人在温柔的心中培养的简单信仰更好的呢？还有什么比这更好的理由是正确的呢？ PSYLLI 和 MARSI：（骑在海牛、海牛和海公羊身上。） 在芬兰的原始洞穴里，没有被涅普顿的海浪淹没，没有被塞斯摩斯击碎，有永恒的微风吹过，我们，我们守卫着维纳斯的战车，像古代一样守卫着它，平静而安宁。
